channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Flattens near 0.6900, falling 20-day EMA warrants downside
item.description: The AUD/USD pair trades in a tight range around 0.6890 during the Asian trading session on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar remains in positive territory after paring recent losses
item.description: NZD/USD inches lower after opening at a bullish gap, trading around 0.5640 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index trades flat at the start of the US NFP data week
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) starts the week on a steady note, with the US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trading calmly near 101.35.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD remains below $59.00 on renewed Hormuz tensions
item.description: XAG/USD depreciates after two days of gains, trading around $58.80 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday. The price of the white metal falls as fresh military clashes between the United States (US) and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz drove oil higher, sparking renewed fears of inflation.

item.title: Japanese Yen softens despite intervention fears
item.description: The USD/JPY pair posts modest gains around 161.80 during the Asian trading hours on Monday, bolstered by uncertainty surrounding US-Iran talks. Nonetheless, the potential upside might be limited amid fears of intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: Canadian Dollar holds ground as US-Iran peace talks resume
item.description: USD/CAD remains in the negative territory for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.4190 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: RBA’s Kent says central bank will be better prepared to handle next crisis
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Assistant Governor Chris Kent said during a review of alternative monetary policy tools that the central bank will be better prepared to respond to the next crisis it faces, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

item.title: Gold falls to near $4,050 amid US- Iran talks uncertainty
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) attracts some sellers to around $4,060 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal declines amid uncertainty surrounding US-Iran talks and hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations. The US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data will take center stage later on Thursday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8175 vs. 6.8166 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8175 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8166 and 6.8041 Reuters estimate.

item.title: British Pound edges lower due to safe-haven demand
item.description: GBP/USD inches lower after opening at a bullish gap, trading around 1.3200 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Iran insists on control of Hormuz amid reports of US talks
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that responsibility for the Strait of Hormuz lies solely with Tehran and warned that any attempt to bypass its preferred route in the waterway will cause “tension and escalation,” Aljazeera reported on Monday.

item.title: Euro remains stronger despite uncertainty surrounding US-Iran talks
item.description: EUR/USD pair maintains its upward momentum for a third consecutive session, trading near 1.1390 during Monday's Asian hours. Despite this positive streak, the Euro’s (EUR) gains could face headwinds if geopolitical uncertainty sparks a flight to safety, boosting the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: UK's Burnham to unveil plan to shift power from London
item.description: The former Greater Manchester mayor and the Labour lawmaker, Andy Burnham, will outline his vision for the United Kingdom (UK) on Monday, the Guardian reported.

item.title: WTI tumbles below $70.00 as US and Iran agree to halt attacks, renew talks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $69.60 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The WTI price falls after reports that the United States (US) and Iran have agreed to pause strikes and plan talks in Qatar on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds steady below 0.6900 on US–Iran talks uncertainty
item.description: The AUD/USD pair trades on a flat note around 0.6895 during the early Asian session on Monday. Traders continue to assess the developments surrounding talks to end the US war with Iran. The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will publish the minutes of its monetary policy meeting on Tuesday.

item.title: Middle East War updates: US, Iran appear to be returning to talks to end the war
item.description: Here’s a brief recap of the key developments in the Middle East war that occurred over the weekend, which are expected to have a significant impact on markets in the upcoming week.

item.title: Vietnam: Strong growth but rising inflation risks – HSBC
item.description: HSBC portrays Vietnam as one of Asia’s fastest-growing economies, supported by booming electronics exports and import-intensive manufacturing.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Gains momentum against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s FX strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that USD/SGD has eased as US Dollar (USD) momentum softened on core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data, with the pair around 1.2960.

item.title: Thailand: AI-linked momentum but 2027 slowdown – HSBC
item.description: HSBC notes that Thailand’s 1Q26 growth beat expectations on the back of strong electronics exports and robust private investment and consumption, supported by AI-related activity and fiscal stimulus.

item.title: South Korea: Exports and inflation support rate hike path – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research’s Ma Tieying expects South Korea’s June exports to remain very strong, with year-on-year growth around 50–60% and the trade surplus widening above USD30bn. AI-related semiconductor demand and higher memory prices are seen offsetting energy imports.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG breaks below $60, bears eye $55
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) price registers gains of nearly 2% on Friday but is poised to finish the week with losses of nearly 10%, as the white metal falls below the $60.00 threshold for the first time since the rally that began at the beginning of December 2025.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Weakness against US Dollar seen as corrective – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s FX strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note USD/CNH’s recent run-up has stalled, with the pair around 6.8020 and daily bullish momentum intact but RSI turning lower from overbought.

item.title: Gold price rebounds as falling US yields weigh on US Dollar
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price recovers some ground on Friday, hitting a two-day high of $4,096 as the Greenback edges lower alongside Treasury yields after investors trimmed hawkish bets on the Federal Reserve (Fed). The XAU/USD pair trades at $4,076, up 1.24%.

item.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: US Dollar faces labor market test as NFP takes center stage
item.description: The upcoming week will bring a fresh test for major currency pairs as investors look ahead to key United States (US) labor market data, ISM Manufacturing figures, Eurozone inflation releases, and central bank commentary from the Federal Reserve (Fed), European Central Bank (ECB), Bank of England (Bo

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Range holds as consolidates against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/SGD has stalled after a six-day advance, with the pair easing to 1.2950 before closing near 1.2970.

item.title: The Japanese Yen got its hike; Tokyo still has to do the rest
item.description: USD/JPY ended the week pressing the 162.00 handle, a whisker beneath its multi-decade high, and the more revealing detail is what it took to drag the Yen up there: a Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hike that was billed as the turning point.

item.title: Taiwan: Undervalued TWD with rotational flows – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY notes that Taiwan’s strong equity performance in 2026 has coincided with net institutional outflows, mainly from U.S. pensions and hedge funds, while APAC and EMEA investors provide support.

item.title: Vietnam: Solid GDP and easing inflation backdrop – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research forecasts Vietnam’s real GDP to grow 7.8% year-on-year in Q2 2026, matching Q1’s pace, supported by strong electronics manufacturing, AI-driven tech demand, FDI and resilient retail spending.

item.title: Canadian Dollar trims gains as US-Iran tensions and hawkish Fed outlook support US Dollar
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trims part of its intraday gains on Friday as uncertainty surrounding a final US-Iran peace agreement and expectations of a hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) help the US Dollar (USD) recover some of its losses after coming under pressure from Thursday's broadly in-line US Perso

item.title: Philippines: Stagflation risks as prices surge – HSBC
item.description: HSBC strategists warn that the Philippines is flirting with stagflation, as slowing Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth coincides with the highest inflation in ASEAN. Weak public spending and cautious households are dragging demand, while the labour market softens.
